counterparty: Bevillesta Pty Limited as trustee for the John Beville (Bankstown) Trust
description: Acquisition of a 75% effective interest in Top Ryde City Shopping Centre, a well-established freehold regional shopping centre in the City of Ryde, Sydney, Australia, for A$393.8 million from Bevillesta Pty Limited as trustee for the John Beville (Bankstown) Trust; completed 19 December 2025, marking Keppel REIT's first pure-play retail asset and strategic diversification into the retail segment.
gain_on_divestment_basis: Not applicable - this is an ACQUISITION, not a divestment; no gain/loss on divestment arises. For reference only (not a gain): 75% purchase price S$334.8m vs independent valuation S$337.597m as-at 31 Dec 2025 => acquired ~0.83% below valuation. Left null to avoid plugging an acquisition discount into a divestment-gain field.

property_name: Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3 (additional one-third interest)
note: Raised aggregate interest in MBFC Tower 3 to two-third; equity-accounted JV via Central Boulevard Development Pte. Ltd. Vendor: Sageland Private Limited (p62). $1,453.0m is the agreed property value basis; no separate independent valuation distinct from the agreed property value was disclosed.
description: Acquisition of an additional one-third interest in Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3, a premium Grade A office tower in the heart of Singapore's Central Business District, at an agreed property value of S$1,453.0 million, from Sageland Private Limited; completed 31 December 2025, raising Keppel REIT's aggregate interest in the asset to two-third.
gain_on_divestment_basis: Not applicable - ACQUISITION, not a divestment. Acquired at an agreed property value of S$1,453.0m; no separate independent valuation of the acquired one-third stake was disclosed. The only as-at 31 Dec 2025 independent valuation for MBFC Tower 3 (S$2,934.7m, Colliers) is for the aggregate two-third interest held after the deal, not attributable to the acquired one-third, so no gain% can be derived without plugging.
